title: Portrait From a Seventies Film
tests: Applies a convincing 1970s film treatment while preserving the uploaded portrait's identity and composition.

faults.what: The strong orange-sepia cast and heavy grain overwhelm some natural colour variation, making the treatment less subtle than a typical faded 1970s film still.

judge.summary: The portrait retains her identity and the original setting with a convincing vintage texture, though the orange grading and grain are somewhat heavy-handed.

must_haves.item: The woman remains recognisable as the woman in the source portrait.
must_haves.why: Her facial features, expression and overall appearance remain consistent with the source.

must_haves.item: Her curly dark hair, sweater and head-and-shoulders framing are retained.
must_haves.why: The same curls, knitted sweater and portrait composition are preserved.

must_haves.item: The park background remains identifiable rather than becoming a different setting.
must_haves.why: The trees, grass, path and bench remain in their original positions.

must_haves.item: Warm, faded colour grading and visible film grain give the image a 1970s film-still appearance.
must_haves.why: Warm amber tones, reduced colour separation, visible grain and subtle film wear create a distinctly vintage appearance, although the treatment is strong.

must_haves.item: The output is square and contains no added text.
must_haves.why: The image retains square framing and has no visible text.
